claims.statement: The living-documents goal's Measure no longer asserts that the pull-request gate inherits scripts/validate.sh, because it does not; the Measure now names tests/test_living_docs.py, which the gate does run, and the Review section records that flipping the goal to active was rejected as a second misstatement rather than a correction. VERIFIED by reading scripts/validate.sh against .github/workflows/ and tests/ at this commit: of the thirteen checks validate.sh runs, eleven reach the pull-request gate because a test in the suite governance-contracts.yml runs applies each validator to this repository's own files; the two with no route in are scripts/quirk_concept.py lint and scripts/validate-copilot-maintenance.py, neither of which has a test module, and quirk-semantic-governance.yml, which runs the registry linter for other repositories, is workflow_call and workflow_dispatch only with no self-caller here. VERIFIED by replaying this branch as a squash onto main at 7c1061ba8867fdce4d903adc7c9589016e3ab002: python3 scripts/validate_evidence_receipts.py --repository Quirk-Systems/.github --root . --receipts .quirk/evidence, the same no-range form the main push step runs, exits non-zero with '.quirk/evidence/correction-instrument-b65eb34a4fd1.json: subject commit must be an ancestor of checked-out HEAD', which is the hazard now documented in EVIDENCE_BINDING.md. VERIFIED at this commit: scripts/validate.sh reports all executed checks passed, and validate_living_docs.py --strict reports 4 documents and 0 stale. UNKNOWN: whether the squash option is restricted on this repository, which is an owner-only setting no file here can read or change.
